sentence: This project builds a machine learning model that predicts which patients with hematologic malignancies will develop atrial fibrillation on tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
This project uses public expression data from Alzheimer's disease brains and electronic records to look for existing drugs that could be repurposed.
This project uses machine learning to predict which emergency department patients are at risk of hepatitis C virus infection.
This project tries to increase research into detecting, preventing and treating drug-resistant infections in West Africa.
This project studies how a stress-related neuropeptide called corticotrophin releasing factor changes visual processing in the primary visual cortex.
This project studies the genetic basis of hip morphological abnormalities and how they affect hip joint degeneration and osteoarthritis.
This project builds and tests a rapid cardiac magnetic resonance imaging exam for heart failure patients that does not require breath-holding.
This project builds a deep learning tool that reads routine histology images to predict genetic mutations and classify risk in several cancers.
This project tries to find out whether CT imaging surveillance in patients with early-stage lung cancer improves survival.
This project gets a bio-layer interferometer that measures interactions between proteins and between proteins and small molecules.
This project explores and translates therapeutic opportunities for patients with kidney cancer.
This project works to bring a diffusion MRI technique that measures mean cell size and cell density in tumors onto commercial clinical MRI platforms.
This project holds workshops and online competitions that give participants chances to work with AI and machine learning in healthcare.
This project uses fruit fly genetics to find out how signaling lipids such as steroids, terpenoids, and eicosanoids are transported.
This project tries to identify genes in tick cells that work in innate immune signaling against microbes such as the Lyme pathogen.
This project studies how checkpoint kinase 2 helps gliomas evade killing by T cells.
This project tries to find out how endometriosis and ovarian cancer are linked, using metabolomics, mass spectrometry imaging and proteomics.
This project tests whether a protein in mitochondria plays a role in secondary spinal cord injury.
This project identifies clinical types of hospital-onset sepsis, predicts which patients develop acute respiratory failure, and estimates the effect of antimicrobial delays.
This project builds platforms that test drugs in human cells to see how they affect the heart in muscular dystrophy.
